signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M₁ : Type u_3} -> {M₂ : Type u_4} -> {M₃ : Type u_5} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid M₁] -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [AddCommMonoid M₃] -> [Module R M₁] -> [Module R M₂] -> [Module R M₃] -> {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₁} -> {B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₂} -> {B₃ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₃} -> (g : B₂ →bᵢ B₃) -> (f : B₁ →bᵢ B₂) -> B₁ →bᵢ B₃

conventions.statement: Arguments are in right-to-left order: `VTask.comp g f` applies `f` first and then `g`, matching standard mathematical and Lean function-composition conventions.
conventions.note: This matches the convention used for LinearMap.comp and function composition in Mathlib.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M₁ : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₁} {B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₂} {B₃ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₃} (g : B₂ →bᵢ B₃) (f : B₁ →bᵢ B₂) (x y : M₁), B₃ ((VTask.comp g f) x) ((VTask.comp g f) y) = B₁ x y

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M₁ : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₁} {B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₂} {B₃ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₃} (g : B₂ →bᵢ B₃) (f : B₁ →bᵢ B₂) (x y : M₁), (VTask.comp g f) (x + y) = (VTask.comp g f) x + (VTask.comp g f) y

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M₁ : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₁} {B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₂} {B₃ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₃} (g : B₂ →bᵢ B₃) (f : B₁ →bᵢ B₂) (r : R) (x : M₁), (VTask.comp g f) (r • x) = r • (VTask.comp g f) x

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M₁ : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₁} {B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₂} {B₃ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₃} (g : B₂ →bᵢ B₃) (f : B₁ →bᵢ B₂) (x y : M₁), (VTask.comp g f) (x + y) = g (f x) + g (f y)

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M₁ : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] {B₁ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₁} {B₂ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₂} {B₃ : LinearMap.BilinForm R M₃} (g : B₂ →bᵢ B₃) (f : B₁ →bᵢ B₂) (x y : M₁), B₃ ((VTask.comp g f) x) ((VTask.comp g f) y) = B₂ (f x) (f y)
